The supplied valuation block places composite fair value at Rs112.3 against a price of Rs98.46, although that gap is method-sensitive.
pillars: Net income is Rs12.70B on revenue of Rs187.70B, with EPS of Rs9.06 in the supplied data.
Forward P/E of 6.24 is below trailing P/E of 10.87, which the supplied scorecard describes as an improving forward view.
Composite fair value is Rs112.3 versus Rs98.46, a stated 14.1% gap, while the valuation block labels the result fair.
Payout ratio is 44.15%, with recent listed distributions of Rs2.0, Rs2.0, and Rs1.0 per share.
The valuation methods include a DDM value of Rs148.81 and a Graham value of Rs222.01, providing higher-method support within the supplied range.
bull_case.best_evidence: The strongest support is the combination of Rs12.70B net income, Rs9.06 EPS, and a forward P/E of 6.24, though EPS basis is unknown.
bull_case.what_would_break_it: The case would weaken if the forward earnings improvement does not materialize, if the 7% margin proves vulnerable, or if the composite valuation gap fails because the valuation methods remain widely dispersed.
bull_case.thesis_ur: تعمیری معاملہ نرم کاری کے کاروبار پر منحصر ہے جس میں Rs187.70B کی رپورٹ شدہ آمدنی اور Rs12.70B کی خالص آمدنی ہے، اور Forward P/E 6.24 بمقابلہ Trailing P/E 10.87۔ فراہم شدہ تقدیری بلاک Rs112.3 کو Rs98.46 کی قیمت کے مقابل منصفانہ قیمت رکھتا ہے، اگرچہ یہ فاصلہ طریقہ منحصر ہے۔
bull_case.best_evidence_ur: سب سے مضبوط حمایت Rs12.70B خالص آمدنی، Rs9.06 EPS، اور Forward P/E 6.24 کی ترکیب ہے، حالانکہ EPS بنیاد نامعلوم ہے۔
bull_case.what_would_break_it_ur: معاملہ کمزور ہوگا اگر Forward آمدنی میں بہتری نہ ہو، اگر 7% حاشیہ کمزور ثابت ہو، یا اگر Composite منصفانہ قیمت میں ناکامی ہو کیونکہ تقدیری طریقے بہت منتشر رہتے ہیں۔

bear_case.thesis: The skeptical case is that the chart remains weak while the fundamental support is uncertain. Price is below both SMA20 and SMA50, the 20-day return is negative, and the valuation methods range from Rs55.58 to Rs222.01 with EPS basis unknown.
pillars: Price Rs98.46 is below SMA20 at Rs102.24 and SMA50 at Rs102.12; the supplied technical memo classifies the structure as downtrend and stance as cautious.
Returns are -2.47% over 5 days and -2.13% over 20 days, while price is 10.37% below the 20-day high and RSI14 is 43.2.
Valuation methods span Rs55.58 to Rs222.01, so the Rs112.3 composite fair value and 14.1% gap are not decisive.
The scorecard describes the 7% net margin as thin, and debt and cash-flow coverage are not in the data.
The supplied news records textile exports stagnating at $17.9bn in FY26, with June exports down 16.71% year over year.
bear_case.attack_on_bull: The weakest bull pillar is the composite fair-value gap: it depends on methods ranging from Rs55.58 to Rs222.01 and an unknown EPS basis, so it does not establish a reliable margin of value.
bear_case.worst_case: A continued move below SMA20 and SMA50 could compound the negative 5-day and 20-day returns; if the thin margin, missing debt or cash-flow information, and weak textile-export context prove adverse, the valuation counterweight would be materially weaker.

bear_case.worst_case_ur: SMA20 اور SMA50 سے نیچے جاری حرکت منفی 5 دن اور 20 دن کے منافع کو بڑھا سکتی ہے؛ اگر سست حاشیہ، غائب قرض یا نقد بہاؤ کی معلومات، اور نرم کاری کی کمزور برآمد کا سیاق و سباق نقصان دہ ثابت ہو تو تقدیری حمایت نمایاں طور پر کمزور ہو سکتی ہے۔
